package.name: race_auv_camera_tag_factorgraph
package.description: Minimal tag36h11 detector for race_auv_factorgraph (dock_fuser): rectify the camera image (cv2), detect tag36h11 with apriltag3 on the CPU, check each detection's image quality, and publish its 4 corners (canonical order) and IPPE pose at the image stamp. One message per processed image, also when no tag is in view. Configuration lives in race_auv_bringup/config/tag_factorgraph_detector.yaml.
